title: On The Lake Kayak Rentals
specs: Delivery and pickup service at New Melones Boat Ramp—no need to transport kayaks yourself
Located next to beautiful New Melones Lake
Open-deck (sit-on-top) kayaks available for beginners and seasoned paddlers
You must be 18 years of age or older to rent a kayak
Minimum age for participants is 4 years old and must weigh over 30 lbs
Minors 13 and under must be accompanied on the water by a parent/guardian 18 years of age or older
Single kayaks have a weight limit of 300 lbs and tandem kayaks have a weight limit of 500 lbs
All minors must be watched at all times by a parent/guardian 18 years or older
Parent/guardian must stay within earshot of minor(s) while on the water
Small dogs under 30 pounds are allowed on kayaks
includes: Paddles and life jackets for all participants
blurb: On The Lake Kayak Rentals offers single and tandem sit-on-top kayak rentals at New Melones Lake. They deliver the kayaks directly to the New Melones Boat Ramp, ready for your reserved time. Rentals are available for both half-day and full-day. The service includes paddles and life jackets for all participants.
extraNote: Cancellations within 24 hours of reservation are not eligible for any refund. All other cancellations receive a full refund. · Rescheduling allowed only more than 24 hours before scheduled reservation. No changes within 24 hours. · $15.00 delivery fee per booking, applied automatically at checkout · You will be charged for any damage or loss of a kayak for the entire cost of the kayak as stated in the waiver (excluding regular wear and tear) · No refunds if you do not use the full rental time · New Melones Boat Ramp in the Glory Hole Recreation Area of New Melones Lake
